name: approval_mask_quoted_newlines
notes: Quote-aware newline masking for shell commands. C port (src/tools/approval_helpers2.c::apr2_mask_quoted_newlines) traced + LIVE Python twin (tools/approval.py::_mask_quoted_newlines); twin also asserts its traced output equals the LIVE fn result on every input. 12 inputs covering: no-newline fast path, single/double-quoted newlines, double-quote backslash escape, unquoted backslash-newline continuation, unclosed quote, trailing newline, mixed quoting.
